items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I was Koochie Martin... And that time I met them fellas... when they were playing, I could beat them all playing.

ctx.x: Now, who was the violin player?

Did they have a violin player? No, he was better with a guitar and a piano player. Yeah. Who was the violin player? Who was the violin player? Yeah. I was Koochie Martin. Koochie Martin, oh yeah. Yeah. And that time I met them fellas, I was little kid. You know, when they were playing, I could beat them all playing. They looked like they all went back. Yeah.
